description: Execute an already-active tool by name. Use this when activate_tools/activate_domain registered a tool but your client did not refresh its tool list. Does not auto-activate inactive tools.

args.description: Arguments object to pass to the tool

arguments.description: Another alternative: MCP clients that stringify the entire arguments wrapper. Carries the same nested {name, args/parameters} payload as a JSON string.

name.description: The tool name to execute (from search_tools or describe_tool results)

parameters.description: Alternative: JSON-serialized arguments string. Some MCP clients serialize the nested arguments as a single stringified-JSON field.

name: call_tool
